privileged_info_for_vlm: There are exactly 30 weight entries. Five entries are outliers with values between 185.6 and 187.0. These must be edited (not deleted) to their kg equivalents (divide by 2.2046), which should result in values between 84.2 and 84.8 kg, rounded to 1 decimal place. The final log must contain 30 entries all within the 70-100 kg range.
